acceptedTags.label: Base-rate neglect

acceptedTags.rationale: The calculation spotlights tiny local probabilities while excluding the background process and denominator essential to the inference.

acceptedTags.rationale: Discrediting an underspecified chance model does not positively establish intelligence as the remaining causal explanation.

acceptedTags.label: Argument from ignorance
